steps.code:
# I can use the liked songs as recommended songs.
# I will fetch all liked songs using pagination.
# Then I will check if there is an API to clear the queue, add songs to the queue, shuffle, and play.

# First, fetch all liked songs.
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    response = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_login_response["access_token"], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not response:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(response)
    if len(response) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total liked songs fetched: {len(liked_songs)}")
